svg.title: EcoSphere — architecture
svg.desc: EcoSphere: Enterprise ESG management platform · NestJS · Prisma · PostgreSQL · React. Sustainability data usually lives in scattered spreadsheets. EcoSphere collects environmental, social and governance records in one system, turns them into department and company ESG scores, and produces reports people review.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
